title: Security & Privacy Awareness Survey 2026: AI use emerges as the greatest vulnerability
content_md:
Security & Privacy Awareness Survey 2026: AI use emerges as the greatest vulnerability. The 5th annual survey by SURF and BDO covered 30 Dutch education and research institutions. Knowledge about cybersecurity is relatively strong among staff but does not consistently translate to safe behavior. AI tool usage is growing faster than policy can keep up: employees resort to public AI tools when no approved, secure alternatives exist, increasing organizational vulnerability. A companion study by The Hague University found 40.1% of staff experienced a cyber incident in the past 2 years, mostly data breaches. Only 17% report being more careful online since. Recommendations include making secure work practices concrete per job role, lowering barriers to safe behavior, and establishing sector-wide AI guidelines with approved alternatives.
